description: Official documentation for Infino — the embedded retrieval engine (SQL, BM25 full-text, and vector search over one copy of your data) and Infino Cloud, the hosted service reached through the same SDK.
rules: Infino is one engine with two ways to run: embedded (connect to memory://, a filesystem path, or an s3://, az://, or gs:// URI — in-process, no server) or hosted on Infino Cloud (connect to https://api.platform.infino.ws/<database> — the https URI switches the SDK to the hosted transport). The create-table / append / search / query_sql surface is the same in both.
Install the same SDK for local and Cloud: 'pip install infino' (Python), 'npm install @infino-ai/infino' (Node.js), or 'cargo add infino' (Rust).

Infino Cloud authenticates with an API key beginning inf_, minted only in the console at platform.infino.ws. Pass it to connect (api_key= in Python, { apiKey } in Node.js, ConnectOptions::new().with_api_key in Rust) or set the INFINO_API_KEY environment variable and omit the argument.

A single Infino Cloud request body is capped at 5 MiB and rejected with HTTP 413 over the cap; nothing is written on rejection. Aim for at most 4 MiB of Arrow data per append batch and treat the last MiB as encoding headroom. Local embedded use has no request cap.
One append is one atomic commit, so batch size is the main ingest-throughput knob: prefer batches near the 4 MiB target over many small appends, and split large loads into a loop.

Run keyword search with bm25_search(column, query, k), vector search with vector_search(column, query_vector, k), and hybrid search with hybrid_search(text_column, text_query, vector_column, query_vector, k) — BM25 and vector rankings fused with reciprocal-rank fusion. All are also SQL table functions composable through query_sql.
Provide your own embedding vectors for vector columns and vector queries; Infino stores and searches vectors but does not generate embeddings.
Not every local capability is available hosted yet — check the local-vs-hosted parity matrix in the API reference before assuming a feature works on Infino Cloud.
Infino Cloud errors are documented with retry guidance: some clear on retry and some do not — consult the Errors & retries page rather than retrying everything.

For AI agents, the Infino MCP server (@infino-ai/mcp-server) exposes the same search tools over local tables and Infino Cloud; LangChain (langchain-infino), CrewAI (crewai-infino), and Vercel AI SDK integrations are documented under Integrations.
